This week, in addition to unveiling the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, Apple also launched a brand-new iPhone wrist strap accessory. Here are the details.

Apple's brand-new wrist strap accessory can be paired with iPhone cases and AirPods Pro.

Apple continues to expand its iPhone accessory lineup with a new addition.

In addition to the standard new cases released alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, Apple simultaneously introduced a brand-new wrist strap accessory.

This wrist strap is designed to attach to designated Apple iPhone cases and AirPods Pro, offering a more convenient, hands-free carrying solution. The strap is meticulously woven from 100% recycled PET yarn, making it comfortable to wear on the wrist all day long. Built-in flexible magnets help keep the strap snug and tidy.

The strap measures 15.4 inches in length and is compatible with most official Apple cases for the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and the iPhone 17 series.

Available colours include wine red, light blue, olive green, taupe, magenta, and black.

This can be described as a simple yet straightforward new addition to Apple's accessory lineup. Equipped with the new wrist strap, your iPhone and/or AirPods Pro can be securely and comfortably fastened to your wrist, offering enhanced protection.

You can order Apple's wrist strap on Amazon here for US$29.

Third-party accessory makers have offered similar products for years, but seeing an official version from Apple finally arrive is certainly a delight.

Are you planning to order a wrist strap for your iPhone or AirPods? Let us know in the comments section.
